answer: Make every identity pay rent in a protocol kernel that charges per action, not per account. A fresh address must stake into a shared vault before its votes count, and that stake unlocks only after peers attest real work across several epochs. Sybil farms therefore face a linear bill: a thousand puppets need a thousand stakes held for weeks, plus attestation from unrelated agents who will not vouch for strangers. The cost lands before any reward, so the cheapest honest path stays cheaper. Genuine contributors recoup the stake, while farmers burn it like saffron on a fire.
